title: Sealed dry run (the rehearsal a sealed run requires)
description: The rehearsal of a sealed run: its exit code and whether it passed. `ok` is true only when it passed. The Python API returns it as verb `run-one --final-test --dry-run`; the command line returns the same `data` as verb `run-one`. A refused verb returns an empty `data` object (the reason is in the envelope's `problems`); when `data` is not empty it carries the required keys.

exit_code.description: 0 passed; 3 the entrypoint exited 0 without acknowledging the rehearsal; otherwise the child's exit code (124 on a time-out).
